title: Co-organising HAID: Human-AI Interaction for Dementia Care at NordiCHI 2024
excerpt: Dr Di Fu co-organised the first HAID workshop at ACM NordiCHI 2024 in Uppsala, Sweden. The workshop focused on human-centred AI for people living with dementia and their caregivers, including deployment challenges and ethical considerations.

provenance.dateEvidence: Official workshop homepage: Sunday Morning (09:00–13:00) 13th October 2024, Uppsala, Sweden. NordiCHI's official programme independently lists Sunday 13 October morning. This is an event date, not a LinkedIn posting date.

titleZh: 共同组织NordiCHI 2024的HAID专题：痴呆照护中的人机交互
excerptZh: Di Fu 博士共同组织了在瑞典乌普萨拉举行的 ACM NordiCHI 2024 首届 HAID workshop。研讨会聚焦于面向痴呆患者及其照护者的以人为中心人工智能，包括部署挑战和伦理考量。
